scope: Browser SFU signaling and lifecycle with fake peers and virtual timers. No assertion of real STUN reachability, SFU connectivity, RTP audio, physical playback or performance.
behavior: At the existing eight-second gathering deadline, a current local SDP candidate permits negotiation to proceed. The original connected-state requirement and 15-second connection deadline still govern readiness. No candidate still rejects; End and replaced output cancel pending waits.
